requirements.text: The existing program's own steps are kept, in order: launch Chromium, open books.toscrape.com, click Travel, then click the first book, print its title and close its own browser (in Rust: attach to the launched browser only once its debugging port answers).
The added step runs right after the Travel click, on the page the program already drives (borrowed or attached), not on a new page or browser.
It extracts, with a language model that is actually named or configured, the title and price of every listed book (a list schema) and outputs the result.
The step never closes, navigates or takes over the program's browser or page: ending or closing its own objects only releases the borrow or drops its connection.
A failure of the step (model, attach, extraction) is caught, and the program continues with its page and closes its browser.
The step is awaited to completion and releases its own resources (connection, Run, Stagehand instance) before the program's driver acts again.

programs.notes: The added step scrapes titles and prices with plain Playwright locators: no language model, no Goodfetch, so the task's AI extraction is not attempted, and nothing catches a failure of the step. The existing program's steps are kept and the step runs on the program's page without closing or navigating it.

api_misuses.assumed: a free function that attaches to a Chromium by its CDP address and returns a browser
api_misuses.doc_says: No such function exists; a browser is reached through Collie::connect/scope, Run::new_session().source(SessionSource::CdpUrl{..}).

api_misuses.assumed: Playwright-style contexts on the attached browser
api_misuses.doc_says: Invented: the SDK has no new_context; pages are opened from a Session (session.new_page()).
Page has no click(selector); clicks go through a Locator (locator(..)/get_by_role(..).click()); the only click(x, y) is a coordinate call on another type.
Invented: no such members exist in the stubs.

api_misuses.assumed: closes the launched Chromium through the SDK object
api_misuses.doc_says: Invented member on an invented type; the spawned process `browser` is shadowed and never killed.

programs.notes: The program uses an invented Playwright-like API (and has a syntax error after spawn()), never waits for the debugging port, and replaces the AI step with a JavaScript evaluation, so no language model is used and no failure of the step is caught: none of it would run as written.
